tiger-global-management._readme: Durable identity corrections for Tiger Global (COLLECTION.md 8): one company filed under several legal entities or renamed is one row; never_merge pairs are two companies the builder must not fold.

merges.reason: Freshdesk renamed itself Freshworks in 2017; both Form Ds name Lee Fixel as director (2013-2016 and 2018).
merges.name: Freshworks

merges.reason: JAND, Inc. is the registered name of Warby Parker (its Form Ds 2011-2018 name Lee Fixel as director; the 2021 listing entity is Warby Parker Inc.).
merges.name: Warby Parker

merges.reason: Decolar.com, Inc. and Satylca S.C.A. are Despegar group entities; the 2012 Form Ds name Charles Coleman and Scott Shleifer as directors of all three.
merges.name: Despegar

merges.reason: TPT Holdco, TPT Investor and Teacher Synergy LLC are the 2014 holding entities of TeachersPayTeachers (Teacher Synergy LLC is the operating company); Lee Fixel is a director on all three Form Ds.
merges.name: TeachersPayTeachers

merges.reason: ADKM, Inc. and HF Global, Inc. are Harry's earlier filing names (one CIK, 1556308)
merges.name: Harry's

merges.reason: 'Bankruptcy of FTX' is a Wikipedia article about FTX, not a second company
Primetrace Technologies is the company behind the Kutumb app
SVMK Inc. is SurveyMonkey's listed parent (renamed Momentive)
UrbanClap renamed itself Urban Company in 2020
WordPress.com is Automattic's product; Tiger invested in Automattic
Danke Apartment's listed parent is Phoenix Tree Holdings
merges.name: Danke

merges.reason: Beleza.Com Ltd. is the Cayman parent of Beleza na Web
merges.name: Beleza na Web

merges.reason: Colony Labs, Inc. is Scribe's legal name ('Colony Labs, Inc. dba Scribe', Scribe's own terms page); one investment
merges.name: Scribe

merges.reason: Sympoz, Inc. is the company behind Craftsy (Denver); Lee Fixel's Form D seat and Wikipedia's Craftsy article describe one investment
merges.name: Craftsy

never_merge.reason: Locus (Locus.sh, Bangalore logistics software) and Locus Robotics (Wilmington, warehouse robots) are two companies
Ola (ANI Technologies, the ride-hailing company; Tiger's Series A of April 2012) and Ola Electric (the scooter maker spun out in 2017; Tiger's 2019 round) are two companies

desk.reason: eLong's 2004 F-1 investors' rights agreement names Tiger Technology Private Investment Partners, L.P. (PIP I, the private-equity desk) as an investor and selling shareholder; the public-desk 13G filer that partitioned the row came after the listing (D2: the partition follows the vehicle the record names).
